title: Binance Accelerator Program - Community & Events (Africa)
description: About the team: The team is a young, dynamic, and ambitious group spread across the African continent, united by a shared belief in Africa’s power to shape the future of finance. Driven by the opportunity to help build the next financial super app in Africa with Binance, they are passionate about expanding access, driving adoption, and creating meaningful impact in the markets they serve. With Africa positioned for extraordinary growth, this team is committed to making the continent a major force in Binance’s journey toward 3 billion users. About the role: Day to day, the intern will help grow and engage Binance’s local community by moderating social channels and chat groups, supporting content creation and localisation, coordinating online and offline events, and assisting with partnerships across universities, developer communities, KOLs, and broader Web2/Web3 ecosystems. They will also support community campaigns, Binance Angels initiatives, and general regional marketing and community operations to ensure Binance remains active, relevant, and well connected in the local market.
